cards.ex: The company's dashed expectations for profit growth led to a stock sell-off.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning foyda o'sishi bo'yicha umidlari puchga chiqqani aktsiyalarni sotishga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan narsa ro'y bermaganda paydo bo'ladigan umidsizlik.

cards.ex: Sending in more troops at this point is a forlorn hope, but we have no other options.
cards.exUz: Bu paytda ko'proq qo'shin yuborish - bu oxirgi umid, ammo bizda boshqa variantlar yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyat qozonish ehtimoli juda kam bo'lgan harakat.

cards.ex: The economic crisis shattered the illusions of prosperity for many families.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy inqiroz ko'plab oilalar uchun farovonlik xayollarini yo'q qildi.
cards.uzDef: Narsalarga noto'g'ri ishonchni yo'qotish, haqiqatni ko'rish.

cards.ex: After losing his job, he sank into the depths of gloom.
cards.exUz: Ishdan bo'shatilgandan so'ng, u g'amginlik tubiga tushib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Ruhiy tushkunlikning eng og'ir holati, chuqur qayg'u.

cards.ex: Living in denial is a fool's paradise; eventually, you have to face reality.
cards.exUz: Inkor holatida yashash - ahmoqlar jannati; oxir-oqibat, siz haqiqatga duch kelishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yolg'on baxt, haqiqatdan bexabar xursandchilik.

cards.ex: I've been on tenterhooks all day waiting for the test results.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun davomida test natijalarini kutib, hayajonda bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir kutayotganda yoki xavotirda juda asabiy bo'lish.

cards.ex: He said he didn't want the promotion anyway, but it just sounded like sour grapes to me.
cards.exUz: U baribir lavozimni ko'tarilishni xohlamasligini aytdi, lekin menga bu faqat yetishmagan uzumdek tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Eriisholm bo'lmagan narsani past baholash.

cards.ex: Despite the challenges, they still harbored bold hopes for the future.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, ular hali ham kelajak uchun dadil umidlarni saqlab qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta maqsadlarga yo'naltirilgan kuchli umidlar.

cards.ex: The economy has been in the doldrums for the past year.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot o'tgan yili tushkunlikda edi.
cards.uzDef: Ish, rivojlanish sekinlashgan yoki to'xtagan davr.

cards.ex: Starting a new business requires a leap of faith.
cards.exUz: Yangi biznesni boshlash ishonch sakrashini talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Dalil bo'lmasa ham, nimagadir ishonish.

cards.ex: We're banking on good weather for the outdoor concert.
cards.exUz: Biz ochiq havoda bo'ladigan konsert uchun yaxshi ob-havoga ishonamiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bo'lishiga yoki muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishiga ishonish.

cards.ex: He lost his shirt gambling at the casino.
cards.exUz: U kazinoda qimor o'ynab so'nggi pulini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta pul yo'qotish, butunlay xonavayron bo'lish.

cards.ex: The fate of the project hangs in the balance pending the board's decision.
cards.exUz: Loyihaning taqdiri kengash qarorini kutib muvozanatda turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Natija noaniq, qaror qabul qilinmagan holat.

cards.ex: Many small businesses fell by the wayside during the recession.
cards.exUz: Kichik bizneslarning ko'pchiligi retsessiya davrida chegarada qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan vazifani bajarishda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: Building a house on the moon is still just a pipe dream.
cards.exUz: Oyda uy qurish hali ham amalga oshmaydigan orzu.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi mumkin bo'lmagan xayoliy umid.

cards.ex: All our efforts to save the company came to naught.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyani qutqarish bo'yicha barcha harakatlarimiz bekorga ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Umidlar, rejalarning natijasiz tugashi.

cards.ex: Sending him to find a solution is a fool's errand; he's never been good at problem-solving.
cards.exUz: Uni yechim topishga yuborish bema'ni ish; u hech qachon muammolarni hal qilishda yaxshi bo'lmagan.
cards.uzDef: Oson ko'ringan, lekin aslida imkonsiz vazifa.

cards.ex: There's a new treatment on the horizon that could cure the disease.
cards.exUz: Ufqda kasallikni davolashi mumkin bo'lgan yangi davolash usuli bor.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The stress of the job is starting to take its toll on his health.
cards.exUz: Ishning stressi uning sog'lig'iga ta'sir qila boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir salbiy ta'siri bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The scandal dashed their reputation to the ground.
cards.exUz: Janjal ularning obro'sini yer bilan yakson qildi.
cards.uzDef: Umidsizlikka solish, harakatlarning samarasiz bo'lishi.

cards.ex: It's a long shot, but it's worth trying.
cards.exUz: Bu ozgina imkoniyat, lekin urinishga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati kam bo'lgan urinish.

cards.ex: The new proposals were given short shrift by the committee.
cards.exUz: Yangi takliflar qo'mita tomonidan etarli e'tiborga ega bo'lmadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga e'tibor berish kerak bo'lgan miqdordan kamroq e'tibor berish.

cards.ex: Losing the game was a bitter pill to swallow.
cards.exUz: O'yinda mag'lub bo'lish - bu yutish qiyin bo'lgan achchiq dori edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan noxush haqiqat.

cards.ex: The joke fell flat and nobody laughed.
cards.exUz: Hazil muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi va hech kim kulmadi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilganidek qabul qilinmaslik, natija bermaslik.

cards.ex: They don't have a snowball's chance in hell of winning the election.
cards.exUz: Ularning saylovda g'alaba qozonish imkoniyatlari nolga teng.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati juda oz, deyarli yo'q.

cards.ex: The professor dashed cold water on my theory by pointing out several flaws.
cards.exUz: Professor mening nazariyamni bir nechta kamchiliklarni ko'rsatib, umidimni so'ndirdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir entusiasmini yoki umidini so'ndirmoq.

cards.ex: After years of competition, the company finally bit the dust.
cards.exUz: Yillar davomida raqobatdan so'ng, kompaniya nihoyat mag'lub bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash, yo'q bo'lish.

cards.ex: The brief economic upturn proved to be a false dawn.
cards.exUz: Qisqa muddatli iqtisodiy o'sish yolg'on tong bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yaxshilanayotganidan yolg'on darak beruvchi vaziyat.

cards.ex: After the accident, he completely lost his bearings.
cards.exUz: Hodisadan so'ng, u butunlay yo'nalishini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Qayerdaligini yoki qanday harakat qilishni bilmay qolish.

cards.ex: Things are finally starting to look up for us after a difficult year.
cards.exUz: Qiyin yildan so'ng, ahvolimiz nihoyatda yaxshilana boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yoki ahvol yaxshilanishi, rivojlanishi.
